system.description: As a Reaction, when a creature you can see within 30 feet of you would take damage as a result of failing a saving throw or being the target of an attack, you may spend a superiority die. They gain a bonus to their AC or Saving throw against the triggering attack or effect. If AC, the bonus is equal to your superiority die result. If Saving throw, the bonus is equal to half your superiority die result.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
